_comment: Permission justification checklist for the store listing + the zip verifier. Keep in sync with extension/manifest.json.

permissions.storage: Persist job cursor, dedup keys and product chunks so a job resumes after the service worker sleeps or the browser restarts. No secrets stored.
permissions.alarms: Heartbeat to wake the service worker and resume a running job; reconnect the app link.
permissions.scripting: Inject the in-page runner into the active tab (per granted domain) to read the DOM/embedded state and drive waits/clicks for extraction.
permissions.nativeMessaging: Talk to the Eloshon Scraper desktop app's native host (job in, progress/results out). Locked to this extension's ID.
permissions.notifications: Tell the user when a challenge needs their action in the tab, or when a site is blocked.
permissions.offscreen: Parse large HTML payloads with a DOMParser off the service worker so parsing never blocks it.
permissions.tabs: Open/track the working tab, drive navigation for pagination and detail pages, and show the per-tab badge.
permissions.activeTab: Screenshot the challenge tab (captureVisibleTab) when a run pauses for user action, so the operator can see what the challenge is instead of describing it. No warning permission; capture is best-effort and never prompts.
permissions.sidePanel: Show the interactive extraction panel (fields, pages, results, settings) beside the page, opened from the toolbar icon. UI only; no extra data access.

optional_host_permissions.*://*/*: Host access is NOT granted by default. The user grants one domain at a time from the popup (a user gesture) before that domain can be scraped.
